newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-O/N RATES LEAP, FRX MKT WAITS FOR BUBA MEETING.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-O/N RATES LEAP, FRX MKT WAITS FOR BUBA MEETING.

text.p: Latvian overnight rates soared on Tuesday morning as liquidity-strapped banks scrambled to meet reserve requirements and the foreign exchange market was quiet ahead of Thursday's Buba meeting in Germany, dealers said.
Overnight rates leapt from Monday's close of bid/ask 1.75/2.50 to 3.0/3.75 late on Tuesday morning.
"There was a surge in demand from local banks this morning...it seems some banks have not fulfilled their reserve requirements," said Maris Vinklers, head of money markets at HansaBank-Latvija.
"Banks lent a lot of money in the first half of the month and now they have to borrow," he said.
Other dealers said they expected the rates to remain relatively high until the end of the month.
In money markets, thing were quiet as local players wait for today's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee Meeting (FOMC) and Thursday's Buba meeting in Germany.
"The Buba meeting is especially important for the local market," said one dealer.
The lat/dollar was trading at 0.5846/51 on the interbank market while the Bank of Latvia intervention rate was at 0.5841.
The market recently witnessed a big demand for lats, prompted by last week's auction of 12 million lats in one-year T-bills and the purchase of a stake in Latvian Gas by Russia's Gazprom.
Dealers said there was nothing looming on the immediate horizon to push the local foreign exchange market either way.
